intent: Check that the API is running
expected: docs/API.md Endpoints / System: GET /health returns {"status": "ok"} when the API is running.
reason: GET /health returned 200 with body {"status":"ok"}, which is what the System section says for a running API.

info.title: P2P Practice API
info.description: A small purchase-to-pay API for practicing API testing. Data lives in memory and resets on restart or with POST /admin/reset. There is no authentication. Every rejected request returns {"detail": "...", "rule": "..."}; 404 responses have no rule.

rule.description: The business rule that rejected the request. Missing on 404 responses.

open_ap_liability.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

unit_price.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.
Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

ordered_value.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

received_value.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

total_amount.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

partial_receipt.description: null until the invoice is matched.

ordered_value.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

received_value.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

invoice_total.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

amount.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

vendor_exposure.description: Amount in dollars, rounded to cents.

get.summary: Check that the API is running

post.summary: Reset all data to the seed state
post.description: Deletes every purchase order, invoice and created vendor, then restores the two seed vendors and the SKU catalog.

get.summary: Get what the business owes a vendor
get.description: open_ap_liability is the sum of total_amount over the vendor's approved invoices (rule: vendor_exposure_math).

post.description: The vendor must exist and be active (rule: inactive_vendor_gate). Each SKU may appear once.
Only a draft can be submitted (rule: workflow_gate).

400.description: The purchase order is not a draft.

post.description: Only a submitted purchase order can receive goods (rule: workflow_gate). Received quantity per line can never exceed the ordered quantity (rule: receive_quantity_limit). The order closes when every line is fully received.

400.description: Invalid body, wrong status or over-receipt.

post.summary: Create a vendor invoice against a purchase order
post.description: The purchase order must be submitted or closed (rule: workflow_gate). Invoice numbers are unique per vendor, compared case-insensitively and ignoring surrounding spaces (rule: duplicate_invoice_detection). Every SKU must be on the purchase order, once (rule: invoice_line_validation). Everything invoiced on the purchase order, quantities and total, can never exceed what was received (rule: overpayment_protection).

400.description: Invalid body or a business rule rejected the invoice.

post.description: Compares the purchase order, the goods received and the invoice. partial_receipt is true when any line of the purchase order is not fully received (rule: partial_receipt_flag). An approved invoice cannot be matched again (rule: workflow_gate).

post.summary: Approve a matched invoice and post it to the ledger
post.description: The invoice must be matched first (rule: three_way_match_gate) and can be approved once (rule: duplicate_approval). Approval posts a balanced ledger entry: debit 5000 Materials Expense, credit 2000 Accounts Payable (rule: gl_balance).

expected: docs/API.md Basics: the same API is also described by the generated OpenAPI document, downloadable at /openapi.json. A successful response is that OpenAPI document.
reason: GET /openapi.json returned 200 with an OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled P2P Practice API, which is the generated document the Basics section points to.

intent: List vendors and pick an active one
expected: docs/API.md Endpoints / Vendors: GET /vendors lists all vendors. Seed data: vnd-001 Maple Ridge Supply is active and vnd-002 Old Quarry Materials is inactive.
reason: GET /vendors returned 200 with both seed vendors: vnd-001 Maple Ridge Supply active true and vnd-002 Old Quarry Materials active false.

intent: List SKUs and take two catalog prices
expected: docs/API.md Endpoints / Catalog: GET /skus lists the five SKUs with their catalog prices. Seed data prices: LUM-2X4-8 4.75, PLY-12-4X8 22.40, CEM-30KG 11.90, REB-10MM-6 18.25, SCR-DECK-1LB 9.99.
reason: GET /skus returned 200 with five SKUs and catalog prices 4.75, 22.4, 11.9, 18.25 and 9.99, matching the Catalog and Seed data sections.

intent: Create a unique vendor for the rest of the flow

body.detail: Request body is not valid JSON.

expected: docs/API.md Errors: an invalid body returns 400 with rule validation_error. Endpoints / Vendors: POST /vendors with a non-empty name returns 201 and creates a vendor.
reason: POST /vendors returned 400 with rule validation_error and detail that the request body is not valid JSON, so no vendor id was created. The Errors table documents that rejection for an invalid body.

intent: Create a unique vendor for the rest of the flow

body.detail: Request body is not valid JSON.

expected: docs/API.md Errors: an invalid body returns 400 with rule validation_error. Endpoints / Vendors: POST /vendors with a non-empty name returns 201.
reason: POST /vendors returned 400 with rule validation_error and detail that the request body is not valid JSON, so no vendor id was created. That matches the Errors table for an invalid body.

intent: Create a unique vendor for the rest of the flow
expected: docs/API.md Endpoints / Vendors: POST /vendors creates a vendor. name is required. active defaults to true. Returns 201.
reason: POST /vendors returned 201 with id vnd-7608b268, name Explorer North Dock 20261026, and active true, which is a new vendor with the default active flag.

intent: Create a draft purchase order with two catalog lines
expected: docs/API.md The purchase-to-pay flow step 2 and Endpoints / Purchase orders: POST /purchase-orders creates a draft PO and returns 201. Lines show received_quantity, plus ordered_value, received_value and fully_received.
reason: POST /purchase-orders returned 201 with id po-776186ed, status draft, received_quantity 0 on both lines, ordered_value 76.7 (2*4.75 + 3*22.4), received_value 0 and fully_received false.

expected: docs/API.md The purchase-to-pay flow step 3 and Endpoints / Purchase orders: POST /purchase-orders/{poId}/submit moves a draft to submitted and returns 200.
reason: POST /purchase-orders/po-776186ed/submit returned 200 and status submitted. Quantities, ordered_value 76.7, received_value 0 and fully_received false were unchanged.

intent: Receive every ordered unit of both lines
expected: docs/API.md The purchase-to-pay flow step 4 and Endpoints / Purchase orders: POST /purchase-orders/{poId}/receive on a submitted PO closes the PO when every line is fully received.
reason: POST receive returned 200 with status closed, received_quantity 2 and 3 matching the ordered quantities, received_value 76.7 and fully_received true.

expected: docs/API.md Endpoints / Invoices: POST /invoices returns 201 with status received, matched false and partial_receipt null. The purchase-to-pay flow step 5: the invoice starts as received.
reason: POST /invoices returned 201 with id inv-f7860a56, status received, matched false, partial_receipt null and total_amount 76.7 for the two received lines.

intent: Run the 3-way match on the full receipt
expected: docs/API.md Endpoints / Invoices and Business rule 5 partial_receipt_flag: POST /invoices/{invoiceId}/match sets status matched and partial_receipt true only when any PO line is not fully received. The purchase-to-pay flow step 6: the invoice becomes matched.
reason: POST match returned 200 with status matched, matched true, partial_receipt false, and ordered_value, received_value and invoice_total all 76.7. Both lines were fully received, so rule 5 requires partial_receipt false.

intent: Approve the matched invoice and post the ledger entry
expected: docs/API.md Endpoints / Invoices and Business rules 7 and 11: POST /invoices/{invoiceId}/approve sets status approved, posts a balanced ledger entry where debits equal credits, and returns vendor_exposure equal to the invoice total for this new vendor. The purchase-to-pay flow step 7: the invoice becomes approved and a ledger entry is posted.
reason: POST approve returned 200 with status approved, debit 5000 Materials Expense 76.7 equal to credit 2000 Accounts Payable 76.7, balanced true, and vendor_exposure 76.7, the same as the invoice total.

intent: Check exposure for the vendor created in this run
expected: docs/API.md Endpoints / Vendors and Business rule 11 vendor_exposure_math: GET /vendors/{vendorId}/exposure returns open_ap_liability equal to the sum of total_amount over that vendor's approved invoices, and lists those invoice ids. The purchase-to-pay flow step 8: exposure is what the business owes that vendor.
reason: GET /vendors/vnd-7608b268/exposure returned 200 with open_ap_liability 76.7, equal to approved invoice inv-f7860a56 total_amount 76.7, and approved_invoices containing that invoice id.
